positions.title: Software Engineer 2
positions.description:
* Engineered end-to-end authentication and authorization workflows, supporting openID connect (OIDC) protocol to ensure secure, reliable interoperability for enterprise clients.
* Researched and prototyped new IAM capabilities, bridging our internal identity infrastructure with external enterprise ecosystems such as Okta to expand product market fit.
* Designed and executed comprehensive testing strategies spanning unit, integration, and security validation for external IdP (Okta and Entra ID) hook-ins.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Round Rock, Texas, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
• Built and maintained Dockerized PostgreSQL solutions, including versioned, test-ready default configurations to support consistent deployment and testing
• Developed RESTful APIs for uploading and downloading database backups, supporting a unified backup workflow
• Contributed to a major codebase refactor to standardize and consolidate backup functionality across systems

positions.title: President
positions.description: • Lead executive council of eight officers in the planning and executing of 100+ events throughout the year

positions.title: Director Of Technology
positions.description:
• Oversee technical solutions for the organization including the website, mobile application, database, and email automation
• Lead 3 committees to uphold the pillars of HBSA and facilitate annual events such as chair retreat and Ellas Conference
• Manage technical logistics for over 120 events throughout 2022-2023 academic year

positions.title: Technology Committee Chair
positions.description:
• Collaboration in the creation of the first mobile application utilizing flutter to improve the experience of HBSA members
• Update organization website on a weekly basis to update partners and members on current events, accolades, and more
• Hosts bi-monthly technology events to educate our members on topics such as human-centered data and design thinking
• Coordinated app feedback event to analyze user experience and relay information to app developers
• Conducted audit of HBSA website to ensure accurate information is displayed to our members and partners

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
• Reduced deployment of key management server from 60 to 12 minutes using Ansible, proprietary code base, and REST APIs
• Debugged code using PDB and test case analysis, to successfully identify a solution after exploring 3 software alternatives
• Documented projects and findings on Confluence by improving and leveraging existing development documentation
• Communicated project progress, blockers, and aligned teams for success using Jira and Scrum principles in daily stand-ups

positions.title: Data Science Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
• Provided academic support to students by facilitating office hours and assisting with R and statistical concepts
• Monitored students' progress by attending class sessions and providing troubleshooting assistance
positions.insights: Skills: R · Data Analysis · Teaching · Statistics · RStudio

positions.title: Start Intern
positions.description:
• Evaluated client data utilizing Alteryx and Power BI to make data visualizations based on the client’s website activity
• Constructed partnership strategy to bridge the gap between client’s supply and demand of services

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
• Honed knowledge of statistical methods and machine learning techniques (LASSO regression & Ridge regression) using R
• Examined ransomware data to understand what organizations are targeted by such attacks and complied a research report

positions.title: Client Services Intern
positions.description:
• Implemented analytics tool (Salesforce) for client services, marketing, and sales team resulting in increased conversion rate
• Organized and ran biweekly meetings with superiors to debrief past client meetings and discuss company growth prospects
• Networked with 10+ business professionals to learn more about career opportunities and improve client services division

volunteerExperiences.companyName: Texas Master Naturalists, Capital Area Chapter
volunteerExperiences.description:
• Provide 40+ hours of volunteer service each year and participate in 8+ hours of continued advanced training, with emphasis on native plant stewardship and community engagement
• Collaborate with local conservation partners including Keep Austin Beautiful, Lady Bird Johnson Wildflower Center, and Balcones Canyonlands Preserve
